payload.title: Compose durable owner-grant authority and host worker enforcement
payload.description: Owner: cross-account-sharing; integration partner monitoring-central (PR58 owner). Depends on delegation contract and separately coordinated hosted integration. Durable conditional grant/revocation/audit/request reservations, fresh owner/consumer authority, guarded execution, immutable billing attribution and caller-specific receipt access. Never convert sharing into owner membership or console:write. Test concurrency, revocation during execution/disclosure, uncertain provider reconciliation and private history exclusion. Production target approval and credentials remain pending. Does not block original four-output priming.
